violation_type.title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Remaining Training Topics (26 TAC §747.1305(e))
violation_type.short_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Remaining Training Topics
violation_type.typical_finding: In review of an assistant caregiver's file, 6 hours of annual training was not available for review.

finding_variants.text: In review of an assistant caregiver's file, 6 hours of annual training was not available for review.
